name: Smooth Visual Hull Reconstruction
definition: Voxelization of a surface defined as the product of n filtered silhouette images. The surface is the isosurface S(p) = 0.5, where S(p) is the product of silhouette values projected into NVC space.
summary: Smooth Visual Hull Reconstruction voxelize a 3D surface by defining it as the isosurface of a continuous scalar field constructed from the product of filtered 2D silhouette images from multiple camera views.
